declarations.name: VeraDialog
declarations.description: A modal dialog over the author's own <dialog>: wired in place, opened by the platform's invokers or a trigger, named by its heading, light-dismissible on request, with a host open attribute that binds both ways and a CSS-only sheet placement.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Observed. Present: the dialog is open as a modal; written by the app it opens or closes it, and a user close (Escape, a form, an invoker, an outside press) removes it, so bound state stays in step. Not the <dialog>'s own open, which is HTML's non-modal attribute.

attributes.name: dismiss
attributes.description: Read at connect. "outside": a press and release both outside the dialog close it (closedby where the engine has it). Never for role="alertdialog".

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Read by the sheet. "end", "start" or "bottom": docked to that edge, sliding in (a sheet). Default centered.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: A direct child <button> that opens the dialog (the platform's commandfor and command="show-modal").

cssParts.name: title
cssParts.description: Optional, the dialog's name when it has no heading: an element marked data-vera-part="title".

cssParts.name: description
cssParts.description: Optional, the dialog's description (aria-describedby): an element marked data-vera-part="description".
